text: יהוה shall reign; Peoples tremble! He is enthroned on the keruḇim; The earth shakes!
יהוה is great in Tsiyon, And He is high above all the peoples.
They praise Your Name, great and awesome, It is set-apart.
And the strength of the Sovereign Shall love right-ruling; You Yourself shall establish straightness; You shall execute right-ruling And righteousness in Ya‛aqoḇ.
Exalt יהוה our Elohim, And bow yourselves at His footstool, He is set-apart.
Mosheh and Aharon were among His priests, And Shemu’ĕl was among those calling upon His Name. They called upon יהוה, and He answered them.
He spoke to them in the column of cloud; They guarded His witnesses And the law He gave them.
You answered them, O יהוה our Elohim. You were a forgiving Ěl to them, Though You took vengeance on their deeds.
Exalt יהוה our Elohim, And bow down towards His set-apart mountain; For יהוה our Elohim is set-apart.
